title: Pre-Export Row Scaling in Generated Mixed-Integer Programs: Mechanism Attribution and Residual-Budget Contracts

creators.name: Rodríguez Castro, Mathias
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad de la República, Montevideo, Uruguay

description: Research artifact for the manuscript "Pre-Export Row Scaling in Generated Mixed-Integer Programs: Mechanism Attribution and Residual-Budget Contracts", prepared for Computational Optimization and Applications. The release contains the C++ exporter and scaling implementation, analysis and independent verification scripts, and stored experiment data: a fixed-basis audit of 306 generated dispatch models, a matrix attribution audit of 1,080 exports, 240 reconstructed operational runs with two matched sensitivity reruns, and 4,752 optimizer calls across HiGHS, Gurobi and CPLEX. Online Resource 2 includes the exact Online Resource 1 PDF and passes the documented audit after extraction. Bulk LP exports and bases are supplied separately as fixed-basis-exports.tar.zst. Source code: MIT; data and aggregate results: CC BY 4.0; the manuscript is outside those licenses. Journal submission, acceptance and publication are not claimed.
